criteria.wait_parity_collapse: oracle < 2 and wait=0 and max model < 2
criteria.too_easy_ceiling: min 4-model primary >= 70, or Hy3 Full primary >= 70 on a row without CPU baselines
criteria.oracle_yardstick_broken: beats_oracle and oracle < 10 and not keep_headroom; 0.17 cannot rank
criteria.cpu_headroom: oracle>=15 and greedy <= 0.55*oracle (wait is the third CPU arm)
criteria.cpu_greedy_peer_strong: greedy >= 0.7*oracle and oracle>=20; keep when models still lag the heuristic
criteria.hy3_zero_unresolved: Hy3 Full ok primary == 0, difficulty high/extreme, horizon >= 17; not treated as dead without an oracle
